crossRefs.note: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up…
When you build a new house, then you shall make a railing around your roof, so that you don’t bring blood on your house…
At evening, David arose from his bed and walked on the roof of the king’s house. From the roof, he saw a woman bathing…
The houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Judah, which are defiled, will be as the place of Topheth, even…
What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.
translations.bsb: but they could not find a way through the crowd. So they went up on the roof and lowered him on his mat through the tiles into the middle of the crowd, right in front of Jesus.
translations.kjv: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
translations.asv: And not finding by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
